market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $120 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month at $104-108 with intraday spikes to $110 today (Apr 30). Question is HIGH of $120 in May. Need a ~$10 move higher within May given Iran/Strait of Hormuz tensions. Risk premium substantial; if Trump briefing translates to action, spike to $120+ very plausible. But baseline absent escalation: only marginal probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether US-Iran tensions escalate to actual military action in May, which would likely send oil through $120.
